benefit_text: The scheme gives a margin‑money subsidy for new micro‑enterprises. General category applicants pay 10% of project cost and receive 15% subsidy in urban areas, 25% in rural areas. Special category applicants pay 5% and receive 25% subsidy in urban areas, 35% in rural areas. Upgrading existing units gets 10% contribution and 15% subsidy, 20% in NER and hill states.
who_can_apply: Any individual aged 18 years or older can apply. There is no income ceiling. For projects over Rs.10 lakh in manufacturing or Rs.5 lakh in business/service, a minimum VIII standard education is required. Existing subsidised units are not eligible.
documents: Caste Certificate, Project Report, Education or skill development training certificate
how_to_apply: Visit the official PMEGP website. Click the Apply button under the appropriate tab for new or existing units. Fill in the online form, upload the required documents, and submit the application.
